name: Hajimete no Kokuhaku
source:
My name is Chika Ando.
Everyone knows I'm a very shy girl.
Well, because of my father's job, I have to move tomorrow.

I have a very special person in my life.
As I am going away, I have decided to tell him how I really feel about him.
I know it is scary but I know I have to do it.

But, I'm really concerned about how he will react...
Actually, he may be annoyed or even be mad at me.
Because,, he is my teacher.

The game progresses according to Chika's point of view.
As Chika is such a shy girl, she cannot decide what to do.
Please, help out Chika. She needs you to guide her through her difficult moment.
Please be gentle with her.
Yes, of course you will experience multi-endings!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047151.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
